model: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5), reading the segment images directly
procedure: The three segments with the lowest Tesseract scores were stacked into one image without looking at their ground truth; the transcription was written down before comparing. Cut-off fragments of neighbouring words at the left edge were left out; a cut-off letter at the right edge was transcribed as seen.
